lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (u : E), ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ P : E →L[ℝ] E, P.IsPositive ∧ P.adjoint.comp P + InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ u u = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E
approved_definition_context: rankOne R u u is the bounded linear operator sending x to the real inner product of u and x multiplied by u. IsPositive means that the operator is self-adjoint and its quadratic form is nonnegative on every vector. .adjoint is the Hilbert-space adjoint, .comp is composition, and id is the identity bounded linear map.
